texts.preamble: D. Sudheer Kumar vs The State Of Telangana on 13 August, 2024 Author: B. Vijaysen Reddy Bench: B. Vijaysen Reddy Honourable Sri Justice B. Vijaysen Reddy Writ Petition No.21365 Of 2024 Order:
texts.facts: This writ petition is filed to declare the inaction of respondent Nos.3 and 4 pursuant to the representations submitted by the petitioner on 08.01.2024 and 09.03.2024, as being arbitrary and unconstitutional. 2. The case of the petitioner is that he is resident of Adilabad Town. One day, he visited some wine shops at Adilabad Town. He observed that the owners of wine shops are not maintaining the wine shops strictly in accordance with the conditions of license and are doing illegal business by selling food in the permit rooms which is illegal as per the Excise Act. The petitioner suffered illness due to unhygienic conditions in the wine shop. Many of the wine shops in Adilabad Town are selling soda in disposable glasses and unhygienic food without the approval of Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI). The petitioner made several oral complaints to the respondent authorities to take action against the wine shops who are conducting business contrary to the conditions laid down in the conditions of license. Later, the petitioner lodged complaints dated 07.02.2022, 08.01.2024 and 09.03.2024. However, there is no action from the respondent authorities. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Prohibition and Excise submitted that the writ petition is not maintainable. The petitioner does not have locus standi to seek for a general order against all the wine shops in Adilabad Town.
texts.arguments: The petitioner has not made any specific complaint against the wine shops.
texts.respondent_arguments: The petitioner has not made any specific complaint against the wine shops.
